GRADE 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. select relevant reading materials from a collection of books,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials completely.
   C. Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials.

2. About Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. scan a text to obtain specific information,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials completely.
   C. Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials.

3. About Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. skim through digital or print texts to establish appropriateness and relevance,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials completely.
   C. Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials.

5. About Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify comparative and superlative forms of adjectives in a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives.

6. About Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. order adjectives in terms of size, shape and age appropriately,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives.

7. About Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. use the comparative and superlative forms of adjectives accurately,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 5.3.1 Word Class: Adjectives.

9. About Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the parts of a narrative composition,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions completely.
   C. Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions.

10. About Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. write coherently on different topics,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions completely.
   C. Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions.

11. About Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. create a narrative composition for self-expression,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions completely.
   C. Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 5.4.1 Creative Writing: Narrative Compositions.

13. About Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise sounds /ʌ/ /ɑː /, words, and phrases correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

14. About Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. listen for the main idea and specific details for effective communication,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

15. About Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. recognise sounds /ʌ/ /ɑː /, words, and phrases correctly,
   B. Learners should ignore Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

17. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify words, phrases, and sentences containing the target sounds/p/ /b/ from texts
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

18. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. construct sentences orally using words related to the theme,
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

19. About Pronunciation and Vocabulary while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify words, phrases, and sentences containing the target sounds/p/ /b/ from texts
   B. Learners should ignore Pronunciation and Vocabulary completely.
   C. Pronunciation and Vocabulary is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Pronunciation and Vocabulary.

21. About Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. select unfamiliar words and phrases from a reading text,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues completely.
   C. Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues.

22. About Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use contextual clues to infer the meaning of words from a text,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues completely.
   C. Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues.

23. About Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. respond to direct and inferential questions for comprehension,
   B. Learners should ignore Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues completely.
   C. Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Reading 6.2.1 Intensive Reading Comprehension Dialogues.

25. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:.

26. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. use quantifying determiners few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least appropriately in a variety of contexts,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:.

27. About Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. identify quantifying determiners: few/ a few, little/ a little, a lot of/ lots of, each, all, enough, most, least in a variety of texts,
   B. Learners should ignore Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: completely.
   C. Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers: is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Class: Determiners: Quantifiers:.

29. About Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition in a conversation with a classmate, which statement is correct?
   A. choose possible topics for pictorial compositions,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition completely.
   C. Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition.

30. About Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition when reading a story about Kenya, which statement is correct?
   A. create a composition based on the visuals or pictures,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition completely.
   C. Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition.

31. About Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition while writing in your exercise book, which statement is correct?
   A. choose possible topics for pictorial compositions,
   B. Learners should ignore Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition completely.
   C. Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Writing 6.4.1 Creative Writing: Pictorial Composition.
